target.title: fix(ui): clear session labels across subscribed clients
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users clearing a session label in one Control UI client would leave other subscribed clients showing the old name until a full session refresh.

## Why This Change Was Made

Gateway session events now send explicit null tombstones when a label or its derived display name is absent, while preserving explicit rename-flow overrides. The Control UI reconciliation path removes those fields when it receives the tombstones instead of merging stale values forward.

## User Impact

Cleared session labels disappear immediately across subscribed Control UI clients without requiring a refresh.

## Evidence

- Before-fix Testbox regression: `sessions.changed` label assertion received `undefined` instead of the required `null` tombstone.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwrtnmmqnd87cx8wrkhz1fmm`: gateway regression 48/48 passed across both gateway configurations.
- Same Testbox: Control UI reconcile regression 1/1 passed.
- Same Testbox: `pnpm check:changed` passed core production/test typechecks, changed-file lint, and repository guards.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main`: clean after the changelog-policy fix; no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact-head CI: 65 successful checks, zero failures.
- AI-assisted. No screenshot included because this is a nonvisual event-reconciliation fix covered at both producer and consumer boundaries.
